headline: A tidier Project view, from beta feedback – with lengths, a way back and the hidden shortcuts on show.
notes: See how long your media is: the whole project beside Project status, used and not used on the switch, and every file beside its bin
Point at a row for Source and Find buttons – each tip names its shortcut, and Settings › Display › Hover tips turns the tips off
Project status › before a clip or sequence name takes you back to where you were
A second tour, for the Project view, plays the first time you open it
The Project view's title now reads Project status
Clip tags and Summary + bars have moved out of Filters into Settings › Display
The Trace+ logo is gone from the top of the panel, and from Settings
The Handover check is leaving Trace+ to become its own panel. Offline files still go to _OFFLINE and back to their bins once relinked
